newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania one-week rate rises to 53 pct from 51 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania one-week rate rises to 53 pct from 51 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said its one-week minimum permitted rate rose by two percentage points to 53 percent at Thursday's auction, when refinancing funds available doubled from the previous session.
The central bank's offer soared to 2.315 trillion lei from 1.05 trillion lei last week.

Local bankers said the upswing in refinancing funds reflected a seasonal trend. The BNR had to accept a larger monetary expansion and inject leu liquidity into the banking sector before the Christmas and New Year holidays.
But the Bank balanced this by making its funds more expensive, raising the minimum permitted rate, bankers said.
